# Aunt Euphemia

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052)</sub>
- **Role:** Housekeeper at Tabby's Place  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Aunt Phemie  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>

## Appearance

She is small and elderly with a gently triangular face and silver-white hair arranged in charming small rolls above her ears. She has big, tender blue eyes brimming with youthfulness and rose-colored cheeks. Her clothing and general appearance reflect an outmoded style.

_Sources: [v3 c16 P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052), [v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)_

## Personality

Aunt Euphemia is an affectionate, cheerful, and indulgent woman who possesses a youthfulness of spirit and gentle humor. She openly acknowledges her outmoded views and lifestyle while remaining remarkably open-minded and relaxed, refusing to strictly supervise the college girls living under her care. Though she occasionally delivers firm or traditional rebukes, her warmth and flattering kindness make her deeply adored by those around her.

_Sources: [v3 c16 P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 c16 P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052), [v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 c25 P4](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0004), [v3 c25 P10](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0010), [v3 c25 P12](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0012), [v3 c37 P13](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0013)_

## Abilities

- Knitting  <sub>[v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 c25 P2](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0002)</sub>

## Goals

- To keep a comfortable and relaxed home for the college girls in Portmaris  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)</sub>

## History

Aunt Euphemia was left alone in a large house after her only daughter married and departed for missionary work abroad. When her niece Mabel Colby proposed managing a residence for herself, Nell, and Honora while they attended Wexcombe College, Aunt Euphemia agreed to move to Portmaris to act as their housekeeper. At Tabby's Place, she brought along her cat Joseph, which her friend had entrusted to her before moving to Vancouver, and she helped integrate Nell's rescue cat Smudge into the household. Over three winters, she provided a warm, hospitable home filled with firelight, rocking chairs, and pleasant company for the student group. She maintained that while college education could impart wisdom quickly, decades of real life experience had taught her even more.

_Sources: [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P48](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0048), [v3 c16 P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 c16 P55](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0055), [v3 c16 P56](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0056), [v3 c25 P12](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0012), [v3 c37 P12](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0012), [v3 c37 P14](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0014)_

## Background by volume

- Her legal given name is Jamesina, named after her father James who drowned a month before her birth  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>
- Grew up in a family with around six girls  <sub>[v3 c19 P42](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0042)</sub>
- Had a single daughter, Elizabeth, who married and left for the foreign mission field  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c36 P11](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0011)</sub>

## Quotes

> However, I am outmoded myself. My garments are, and naturally my views are as well. Remember, I am not claiming they are superior because of it. Indeed, I suppose they are likely much inferior. Nevertheless, they have proven quite comfortable through use.  <sub>[v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)</sub>

> I am aware you anticipate that I will supervise you and maintain your propriety, yet I refuse. If you will ever understand how to conduct yourselves, you are at an age to know it now. Therefore, as it pertains to me, you are all free to ruin yourselves as you see fit.  <sub>[v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)</sub>

> Once your soul is afflicted with rheumatism, you may as well proceed to select your coffin.  <sub>[v3 c25 P10](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0010)</sub>

> You have attended college for four years while I never did, yet I possess far greater knowledge than you do, young ladies.  <sub>[v3 c37 P14](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0014)</sub>
